Quickstart

Read a holder's totem, check eligibility and trigger an evolution from any wallet, game or community app.

evolve.ts
import { Totem } from "@totem/sdk";

const bbc = Totem.community("bbc.totem.near");

// time-weighted, not a one-block snapshot
const proof = await bbc.eligibility("ada.near");
// { hold: true, streakDays: 34, quests: 1, tier: 3 }
if (proof.ready) {
  await bbc.evolve("ada.near", { branch: "meme-commander" });
}
